name: Hauler Hero
desc:
Customer Success Associate | $20.50-$24.52/hr | Account Management, Email and Video Call Heavy 
https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/hauler-hero/c17065e7-af4e-45fc-8142-ea99e5a1dae4

Industry: Technologies
 Realistic Job Overview and Responsibilities:
 Hauler Hero is a cloud-based SaaS platform that helps waste-hauling companies optimize operations, increase efficiency, and reduce costs. The product bundles CRM, drag-and-drop dispatching and routing, billing, reporting, a mobile driver app, and customer-facing portals, plus AI features for automated documentation and route optimization. This role manages a defined portfolio of customers after they have already been onboarded onto the platform, with the goal of keeping them engaged, satisfied, and renewing their contracts.

 Key responsibilities from the posting:
Serve as the primary point of contact for customers after implementation
Own account health, engagement cadence, and renewal readiness for an assigned book of business
Conduct proactive check-ins and review how customers are using the platform operationally
Monitor usage metrics to identify customers who are not adopting the product fully
Build and execute action plans to improve customer outcomes
Escalate technical issues through Jira and coordinate with internal teams
Document account status, churn risk signals, and renewal posture
Capture and communicate recurring product feedback 
Partner with Sales to identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts
Contribute to internal playbooks and process documentation
Participate in a rotating weekend coverage schedule
This is a relationship-driven, proactive role rather than a reactive support queue. You own a set group of customers long-term and are responsible for keeping them successful, renewing, and ideally growing their usage of the platform.
assessment: No formal pre-application assessment found in the posting. No detailed candidate interview reports were found specifically for this role at Hauler Hero, so the process is not fully confirmed.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: Not stated in posting.
 Required Experience:
2 to 4 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or client-facing SaaS roles
Direct experience owning retention or renewal outcomes
 Preferred Experience:
Logistics, field service, or operational SaaS background
Experience supporting integrations or workflow configuration
Familiarity with the waste hauling or environmental services industry
 Required Skills:
Strong written and verbal communication
Ability to manage multiple accounts simultaneously
Comfort reviewing usage data to identify churn risk
Workflow troubleshooting and system configuration understanding
Experience with Intercom, Notion, and Jira
Strong organizational discipline and follow-through
 Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with 2 to 4 years of Customer Success or Account Management experience in a SaaS environment
People who are naturally proactive and relationship-oriented rather than purely reactive
Anyone comfortable reading usage data and translating it into action plans for customers
Participants who do not mind occasional weekend coverage as part of a rotating schedule
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone without prior Customer Success or Account Management experience specifically. This is not an entry-level role
Participants who need a fixed schedule with no weekend involvement
People who prefer a single, narrow task rather than owning a full book of business end to end

They want someone who can own a book of customers, stay organized, use data to spot risk, communicate clearly, and keep people renewing. Prior SaaS customer success or account management experience is the biggest requirement.
notes:
This is a genuine mid-level Customer Success role, not an entry point. The 2 to 4 year experience requirement is specific and real, and the responsibilities, owning renewal outcomes, building account plans, identifying expansion opportunities, reflect a role with real autonomy and accountability. Best suited for a participant who already has SaaS or account management experience and is looking for their next step up, not someone starting fresh in customer success.
Hauler Hero itself is a growing company serving a fairly specific niche, the waste hauling industry, which could be a unique resume builder for a participant interested in operational SaaS or logistics-adjacent technology.
Career Pathway: Customer Success Associate → Senior Customer Success Manager → Strategic Account Manager → Customer Success Team Lead → Director of Customer Success
